content.title: 三大时态·过去完成时 / 现在完成进行时 / 将来进行时 速查
content.intro: 本单元三个时态各管一段时间轴:过去完成时=「过去的过去」(had done);现在完成进行时=从过去持续到现在的动作(have been doing);将来进行时=将来某刻正在进行(will be doing)。判断口诀:看时间标志词和「相对哪个时间点」。

headers: 结构 / 时间标志 / 例句
rows: had + 过去分词；before / by the time / after / already / by + 过去时间：When I arrived, the class had begun.
have/has been + doing；for / since / all day / lately / recently / how long：She has been studying for hours.
will be + doing；this time tomorrow / at + 将来时刻 / soon / when you grow up：This time tomorrow I'll be flying to London.

specialRules.rule: 过去完成时是「过去的过去」——必须有另一个过去动作作参照
specialRules.mark: after he had gained his degree, he sailed home

specialRules.rule: 现在完成进行时强调「动作持续、还可能在继续」,常与 for/since 连用
specialRules.mark: Our motherland has been suffering for so long.

specialRules.rule: 将来进行时表示将来某刻「正在进行」,不强调开始或结束
specialRules.mark: When you grow up, you will be studying science.

specialRules.rule: 现在完成进行时(强调过程) vs 现在完成时(强调结果):been doing 看重'一直在做',have done 看重'已做完'
specialRules.mark: have been reading(还在读) / have read(读完了)

why: 三个时态都在表达「相对某个时间点」的动作:过去完成相对过去;现在完成进行从过去连到现在;将来进行落在将来。抓住参照点和持续/进行的含义,就不会混。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空高频:by the time / before / after 引导句中辨过去完成时;for / since / lately 辨现在完成进行时。
this time tomorrow / at this moment next week 等标志,辨将来进行时;别误用一般将来时。
完成进行 vs 完成:题干给出 'and is still doing / 眼睛还红着' 等线索时,优先 been doing(强调持续)。

examVsReal.exam: By the time we arrived, the film had started.（考试/书面)
examVsReal.real: We got there late — the film already started.
examVsReal.note: 考试用 had started 体现'过去的过去';口语里常简化成一般过去时 + already

examVsReal.exam: I have been studying English for three years.（考试)
examVsReal.real: I've been doing English for three years now.
examVsReal.note: 口语里 study 常说成 do;现在完成进行强调'这些年一直在学'

examVsReal.exam: This time tomorrow I will be flying to London.（考试)
examVsReal.real: Same time tomorrow I'll be on the plane to London.
examVsReal.note: 口语常用 be + 介词短语表'正处于某状态',意思与将来进行时相近
